checks.message: Provisional boundary is clearly disclosed. Organizer geometry gaps do not block content scoring; replace and recompute when official polygons arrive.
Three required provisional key areas are present, non-overlapping and unsuitable for official redline or precise-area use.
Land-use polygons cover the submitted boundary without material gaps or overlaps.
Known areas, ratios, lengths, phase areas and key-area areas are recomputed in EPSG:4548.
Offline HTML uses a map derived from submitted GeoJSON and contains no remote dependencies.
Proposal explains taskbook content, geometry, metrics, assumptions and governance boundaries in readable form.
A3 booklet and A0 boards use correct page sizes, consistent metrics and visually inspected layouts.
